primary: mean over four parents of accepted candidate incremental best IR beyond shared baseline-plus-eight-scout pool; compare covariance minus matched random
signal_gate: parent below quality threshold, sample badness std>1e-6, first4/last4 covariance cosine>0; otherwise exact zero step
acceptance: base_badness-candidate_badness>=.05, finite endpoint/reward, and signal gate; keep old candidate pool unchanged on reject. No semantic-preservation guarantee.
proposal: VP forward kernel from input noise level index50 back to index45: q=alpha45/alpha50, sqrt(q)*x50+sqrt(1-q)*Gaussian; original five DDIM transitions45..49 return to exact index50; independent proposal tapes. h0 is this fixed five-step roundtrip.
coupling: Within each root: baseline,8scouts,4correction endpoints share exact50..99 historical tape. Roots and prompt/seed units use independent streams. Same random direction across both caps; random actual BF16 displacement matched to covariance within2%, never larger.
inference: Average4roots then2seeds within each of6 development prompts; bootstrap20000 and exact paired one-sided sign flips. Two cap contrasts Holm corrected. No final/validation/test, no confirmation claim.
progression_gate: At least one covariance accepted endpoint improves on its entire own shared scout pool; its covariance-vs-random primary CI95 lower>0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided p<=.05. This licenses a follow-up design, not automatic compute extension. No allocation/width sweep before review.
stopping: Finish fixed12 units irrespective reward. Stop on integrity/failure or persistent1800s cap. No step backtracking or tuning on new outcomes.

future_rounds.round2: Only after mechanism evidence, freeze cap and compare ensemble widths .5h0,h0,2h0 in a new node.
future_rounds.round3: Only after useful local branching/repair, compare exploration compute fractions .25/.5/.75 with allocation-matched no-covariance controls.

scope: User supplied PDF+request: exploratory mechanism round1 only; not an equal-budget BFS head-to-head or a 2400-NFE winner claim.
